articleTitle: Abnormal Bleeding on Birth Control: When to Worry About Pregnancy
imageHeadline: Spotting on birth control? Here's when to take a test.
imageSubtext: How to tell the difference between breakthrough bleeding and early pregnancy.
pinTitle: Abnormal Bleeding on Birth Control: When to Worry About Pregnancy | Hormones
pinDescription: Breakthrough bleeding is common on hormonal birth control, but it can be confusing when you're trying to figure out if something's wrong. Learn the patterns that matter, what's normal for your method, and when spotting might signal pregnancy instead of a side effect.
